import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { FaUsers, FaTag, FaMoneyBillWave, FaStore, FaChartLine, FaUserCheck, FaCalendarAlt, FaShoppingCart, FaDollarSign } from 'react-icons/fa'; import styles from '../AdminDashboard.module.css'; const SimpleAnalyticsDashboard = ({ analytics }) => { const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState('month'); const handleTimeRangeChange = (e) => { setTimeRange(e.target.value); }; // Format currency const formatCurrency = (amount) => { return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(amount); }; if (!analytics) { return (

Loading analytics data...

); } return (

Analytics Dashboard

{analytics.summary.totalUsers.toLocaleString()}
Total Users
{analytics.summary.activeUsers.toLocaleString()}
Active Users
{analytics.summary.totalCoupons.toLocaleString()}
Total Coupons
{formatCurrency(analytics.summary.totalCashback)}
Total Cashback

User Statistics

{analytics.userStats.newUsers.thisMonth.toLocaleString()}
New This Month
{analytics.userStats.newUsers.percentChange > 0 ? '+' : ''} {analytics.userStats.newUsers.percentChange}% vs last month
{analytics.userStats.activeUsers.thisMonth.toLocaleString()}
Active Users
{analytics.userStats.activeUsers.percentChange > 0 ? '+' : ''} {analytics.userStats.activeUsers.percentChange}% vs last month
{analytics.userStats.verifiedUsers.thisMonth.toLocaleString()}
Verified Users
{analytics.userStats.verifiedUsers.percentChange > 0 ? '+' : ''} {analytics.userStats.verifiedUsers.percentChange}% vs last month

Coupon Statistics

{analytics.couponStats.newCoupons.thisMonth.toLocaleString()}
New Coupons
{analytics.couponStats.newCoupons.percentChange > 0 ? '+' : ''} {analytics.couponStats.newCoupons.percentChange}% vs last month
{analytics.couponStats.expiredCoupons.thisMonth.toLocaleString()}
Expired Coupons
{analytics.couponStats.expiredCoupons.percentChange > 0 ? '+' : ''} {analytics.couponStats.expiredCoupons.percentChange}% vs last month
{analytics.couponStats.redemptions.thisMonth.toLocaleString()}
Redemptions
{analytics.couponStats.redemptions.percentChange > 0 ? '+' : ''} {analytics.couponStats.redemptions.percentChange}% vs last month

Cashback Statistics

{formatCurrency(analytics.cashbackStats.pendingCashback.thisMonth)}
Pending Cashback
{analytics.cashbackStats.pendingCashback.percentChange > 0 ? '+' : ''} {analytics.cashbackStats.pendingCashback.percentChange}% vs last month
{formatCurrency(analytics.cashbackStats.approvedCashback.thisMonth)}
Approved Cashback
{analytics.cashbackStats.approvedCashback.percentChange > 0 ? '+' : ''} {analytics.cashbackStats.approvedCashback.percentChange}% vs last month
{formatCurrency(analytics.cashbackStats.rejectedCashback.thisMonth)}
Rejected Cashback
{analytics.cashbackStats.rejectedCashback.percentChange > 0 ? '+' : ''} {analytics.cashbackStats.rejectedCashback.percentChange}% vs last month

Popular Stores

{analytics.popularStores.map((store, index) => ( ))}
Store Visits
{store.name} {store.visits.toLocaleString()}

Popular Coupons

{analytics.popularCoupons.map((coupon, index) => ( ))}
Store Discount Uses
{coupon.store} {coupon.discount} {coupon.uses.toLocaleString()}
); }; export default SimpleAnalyticsDashboard;
